title: talos.version/1
description: What `talos version --enforced --json` prints: the Talos release a repository enforces, which Thea's hub hands to tasks as TALOS_VERSION and TALOS_SHA.

repo.description: owner/name; null when the release came from the environment outside a clone

version.description: package.json's version at the pinned commit

sha.description: the release commit the pin names

from.description: TALOS_VERSION and TALOS_SHA, the repository's rulesets, or channels.json

pin.description: the pin that was looked up; absent when the release came from the environment

path.description: the gate workflow's path in the Talos repository; null from channels.json
